## 🎯 Why?

What engineering question or user problem does this address?

## 🔍 Evidence

- [ ] I explained what changed in plain language
- [ ] Relevant links, diagrams, reproduction notes, or tests are included
- [ ] I stated limitations or open questions
- [ ] I checked important claims and linked sources when applicable
- [ ] If material AI assistance was used, I verified the result and can explain it
